+var envReference = regexp.MustCompile(`^\$\{[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\}$`)

+// envSubstitutionHookFunc resolves whole-value environment references before
+// subsequent hooks and mapstructure convert values to their destination types.
+func envSubstitutionHookFunc() mapstructure.DecodeHookFunc {
+	return func(_ reflect.Type, _ reflect.Type, data interface{}) (interface{}, error) {
+		value, ok := data.(string)
+		if !ok {
+			return data, nil
+		}
+
+		if !envReference.MatchString(value) {
+			return data, nil
+		}
+
+		if replacement, ok := os.LookupEnv(value[2 : len(value)-1]); ok {
+			return replacement, nil
+		}
+
+		return data, nil
+	}
+}

item.text:
Added `${VARIABLE_NAME}` substitution as the first configuration decode hook. Exact string references use the environment value when present; other values stay unchanged. Existing type conversion handles substituted ports and durations, and normal `FLIPT_` environment overrides retain precedence.

Tests passed: `go test ./internal/config -count=1` and `go test ./config -count=1`. I solved this directly; no delegation or adoption was used.
